title: Mikrotik RB960PGS hEX PoE 5 Port Gigabit Ethernet Router

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MikroTik hEX PoE RB960PGS – Smart 5-Port Gigabit Router with PoE Output

The MikroTik RB960PGS hEX PoE is a high-performance, 5-port Gigabit Ethernet router equipped with four PoE-out ports, making it an excellent solution for setups that require both power and data delivery over a single cable. Whether you're powering wireless access points, IP cameras, or MikroTik devices, the hEX PoE makes installations clean and simple.

With a dual-core 880 MHz CPU, 256MB RAM, and RouterOS, this router handles advanced networking features like firewall, VPN, QoS, and routing protocols effortlessly. Ideal for home, office, or ISP networks, it’s built to deliver reliable, professional-grade performance.

Key Features:

  • 5 Gigabit Ethernet Ports – Reliable high-speed data for LAN/WAN setups
  • 4 PoE-Out Ports – Power MikroTik or passive PoE devices up to 57V
  • RouterOS with Full Features – Advanced networking, firewall, and VPN tools
  • Dual-Core 880 MHz CPU – Powerful multitasking for demanding network environments
  • MicroSD Slot – Optional storage for logging or backups
  • PoE-In Support on Port 1 – Power the router via another PoE source
  • Compact Design – Easily fits into desktop setups or wall-mounted spaces

Perfect For:

  • Small businesses and home offices
  • CCTV networks and IP camera systems
  • MikroTik-based mesh or wireless networks
  • Affordable, high-performance routing solutions
  • Installations needing PoE and routing in one device
